title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo
tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

faults.what: The entire Mooncrumb wordmark is missing; only the gold crescent is visible on either background.

judge.summary: The transparent gold crescent is clean, but the required Mooncrumb lettering is entirely missing.

must_haves.item: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
must_haves.why: No lettering is visible on either background.

must_haves.item: A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
must_haves.why: A gold crescent appears in the upper portion, but there is no name beneath it.

must_haves.item: When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
must_haves.why: The surrounding area takes on both preview backgrounds without a visible rectangle or checkerboard.

must_haves.item: The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.
must_haves.why: The moon edges look intact and free of conspicuous white halos, but the lettering is entirely absent.
